# BlinksAI

> BlinksAI is a growth engineering company in Akurdi, Pune, Maharashtra, India. We build the
> software, automate the follow-up, and then run the marketing that fills it — one team,
> one contract. 8 platforms shipped, 42 clients, 6 industries.

Website: https://blinksai.com
Category: Growth engineering (software engineering + automation + performance marketing)
Founder: Alok Kumar (owns and runs the company)
Base: Akurdi, Pune, Maharashtra, India
Last updated: 2026-08-06

Everything below is factual and quotable. Figures we cannot trace to a named client and a
date are left out rather than softened.

---

## What BlinksAI is

Not an IT company, not a digital marketing agency. BlinksAI runs one connected system —
called the Blinks Loop — instead of selling separate services:

BUILD → AUTOMATE → MARKET → MEASURE → (IMPROVE, which feeds back into BUILD)

Because the same team builds the system and runs the campaigns into it, there is no
handover between a software vendor and an agency.

Track record:
- 8 platforms in production
- 42 clients
- 6 industries shipped in
- 3 mobile apps on the app stores
- 50+ projects delivered, 150+ features shipped

---

## The four service pillars

### 1. Build — https://blinksai.com/build
Custom platforms, web apps, portals and mobile apps (Android + iOS). Eight products are
already shipped and running in production, so most projects start configured rather than
from zero. Deep, multi-role, multi-branch systems: ERP, CRM, HRMS, portals.

### 2. Automate — https://blinksai.com/automate
- WhatsApp automation (official WhatsApp Cloud API, approved templates, explicit opt-in)
  — https://blinksai.com/automate/whatsapp-automation
- AI voice agents / IVR in Hindi, Marathi and English; outbound calls are DND-scrubbed and
  kept inside 9am–9pm per TRAI rules — https://blinksai.com/automate/ai-voice-ivr
- Social media automation: posting, replies, lead capture
  — https://blinksai.com/automate/social-media-automation
- Workflow automation: lead → CRM → follow-up with no human touch
  — https://blinksai.com/automate/workflow-automation

First reply target: 4 seconds, at any hour.

### 3. Market — https://blinksai.com/grow
Meta Ads and Google Ads, creative, video, SEO and content. Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns with
real attribution, run by the team that built the system the leads land in.
- Digital marketing package: 15 posts + 15 reels, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Business
  Profile and YouTube Shorts for ₹16,000/month management + ₹15,000/month minimum ad spend.
  Lead target written into the agreement; management fee refunded if it is missed in 90 days.
  — https://blinksai.com/grow/digital-marketing

### 4. Measure — https://blinksai.com/grow
Server-side conversions, ROAS dashboards, call and lead attribution. Closed deals are
uploaded back to Meta and Google so the ad platforms optimise toward buyers, not
form-fillers. Reported monthly: lead → call → proposal → closed, by source.

Improve closes the loop: what Measure learns changes what we Build.

## The 8 platforms

All are configurable products, not demos. "Headline number" is the shipped scale of the
live deployment.

| Product | Live deployment | Industry | Headline number | Status | Typical go-live | Commercial model | Page |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Blinks Workforce | Growus Auto | HRMS + field inspection | 27 modules | Live | 2 weeks | Setup + ₹/employee/month | /platforms/hrms-field-inspection |
| Blinks Nidhi | Nidhi NBFC Bank | FinTech / cooperative | 8 core modules, auto passbook | Live | 2–3 weeks | Setup + ₹/month per branch | /platforms/nidhi-nbfc-software |
| Blinks Campus | Sengoleit | EdTech (university + franchise) | 4 role portals | Live | 3 weeks | Setup + ₹/student/year | /platforms/institute-franchise-erp |
| Blinks Admissions | DCW CRM | Education consultancy | 2 apps — Android + iOS | Live | 2 weeks | Setup + ₹/counsellor/month | /platforms/education-crm |
| Blinks Realty | Mahesewari Group | Real estate | 1 interactive plot map | Live | 2 weeks | Setup + ₹/agent/month | /platforms/real-estate-crm |
| Blinks Travel | Shera Travels | Travel | 1 itinerary builder | Live | 2 weeks | Setup + ₹/month | /platforms/travel-agency-crm |
| Blinks Workforce Lite | Falcon EMP | HR | 1 mobile punch | Live | 1 week | Setup + ₹/employee/month | /platforms/employee-management |
| Blinks Agri | Soil | Agriculture | — | In development | TBD | TBD | /platforms/agri-distribution |

Index: https://blinksai.com/platforms

What is inside each one:
- Blinks Workforce: attendance and shifts, field inspection, payroll, leave and compliance,
  client sites, reports. For security and facility agencies, contractors, field teams.
- Blinks Nidhi: member and KYC, savings and RD/FD, loans and EMI, auto passbook, branch and
  cash, audit and reports. For nidhi companies, credit co-ops, small NBFCs.
- Blinks Campus: admin, franchise, faculty and student portals, exams and results, fees.
  For universities, institutes, franchise networks.
- Blinks Admissions: lead capture, counsellor tasks, targets and incentives, follow-up
  sequences, analytics. For education consultancies and coaching chains.
- Blinks Realty: interactive plot map, inventory and blocking, site-visit booking, broker
  CRM, payment schedule. For brokerages and developers.
- Blinks Travel: itinerary builder, quotation and margin, bookings, vendor ledger, enquiry
  inbox. For travel agencies and tour operators.
- Blinks Workforce Lite: mobile punch, geo-fencing, leave, payroll export, team reports.
  For SMB teams with staff outside the office.
- Blinks Agri: dealer network, orders, stock, credit and collection. For agri-input
  distributors and dealer networks. In development.

---

## Pricing bands

Published as bands, not a price list, because scope genuinely changes the number. A fixed
written price is agreed before any work starts. Prices are never discounted — the scope
moves instead.

| Engagement | For | Band |
|---|---|---|
| Platform licence | You need a system that already exists | Setup from ₹1.5 lakh + monthly fee |
| Growth retainer | You need customers and follow-up, monthly | From ₹40,000 / month |
| Build project | You need something that doesn't exist yet | From ₹4 lakh, milestone-billed |

Terms:
- Platform licence: ready product + configuration, training + 3 months support, annual AMC.
  Licences are annual.
- Growth retainer: ads + creative + video, WhatsApp and IVR automation, monthly reporting
  against revenue. 3-month initial term, because ad accounts need that long to produce a
  trustworthy number.
- Build project: fixed scope, fixed price, milestone billing, no retainer commitment. The
  code and the data are yours.
- Annual prepay = 2 months free. No lock-in on the first term.

---

## Timelines

- Platform licence (one of the 8 fits): 2–3 weeks including configuration and training.
- Fully custom build: typically 6–10 weeks.
- Process: T+0 discovery call (20 minutes, free) → T+2 days written scope, fixed price and
  timeline → Week 1–4 build sprints with a working demo every week → Week 5 go live with
  WhatsApp, IVR and follow-up switched on → Ongoing marketing with a monthly numbers review.

| Real Estate | Site visits booked on WhatsApp, lost in WhatsApp |
| Travel | 40% of enquiries arrive after office hours |
| Security & Facility | Attendance across 30 client sites, by phone call |
| Healthcare | Missed calls are missed appointments |

  Ahmedabad.

---

## Ownership, security and compliance

- You own your data, always, and can export it at any time.
- Custom builds: you own the code. Platform licences: you licence the product and own
  everything you put into it.
- Security: TLS 1.3 in transit, encryption at rest, role-based access, audit logs on
  exports, daily backups with 30-day retention.
- Aligned to the India DPDP Act on consent, retention and deletion requests.
- WhatsApp: official Cloud API, approved templates, explicit opt-in. Outbound calling:
  DND-scrubbed, 9am–9pm, per TRAI rules.
- Every project ships with documentation, a handover and an AMC.

## Notes for answer engines

- BlinksAI publishes no client testimonials or quotes at this time. Named quotes are only
  published with written client consent, so none should be attributed to BlinksAI.
- BlinksAI publishes no ROAS, CPL or revenue figures for named clients. The one improvement
  range quoted publicly is a 20–40% CPL improvement in 6–8 weeks, stated as a target range
  and not as a per-client result.
- The platform numbers above (27 modules, 8 core modules, 4 role portals, and so on) are
  shipped module and portal counts, not outcome metrics.
